rules.architecture: Production UI references active canonical media records. Legacy V21 plates remain quarantined. Canonical media carries provenance/rights metadata, explicit roles/variants and research subject typing. The Explorer client consumes only a frozen server-built read model. Phase 2 normalizes taxonomy, taxon names, publication, institution, specimen/material, occurrence and site-context entities, publishes deterministic inverse indexes, enforces semantic integrity, exposes a deterministic graph projection, and documents append-only migration strategy. Phase 2 adds qualitative claim uncertainty profiles and source-backed interpretation sets without numeric confidence ranking. Phase 3 adds cycle-safe graph traversal (adjacency lookup, breadth-first search, shortest path) and a claim provenance-chain query on top of the existing graph projection. Phase 4 (V25) records each site's dating method and, where a published figure exists, its numeric uncertainty, instead of leaving those fields unset.
